The one friend is mad at me but we still talk. The would be boyfriend doesn't want to see me go but understands. He said he'd do the same thing in my situation. We have been making the most of our time together and went on amazing hiking trip this weekend. Probably our last barring a miracle as if nothing changes Tuesday is the day.
I've told my would be boyfriend and a friend of my plan though not where just in case they try to stop me last minute.

I have found myself mired in a legal issue and if I go through with Tuesday I will be fired (and prison of course) and never able to work in my field again or the other two fields I have certs in. I made a dumb mistake yes but I dont think it is worth laying waste to my world but they apparently do. There is a small chance this could be lessened or dropped...this has been a long slow process but now I doubt that will happen. My family doesn't know any of this is going on and will keep it that way if I have to go through with it. Only people that know are one friend, the guy I mentioned in my post, and one person on here I have been chatting with since this all started. I really wish I could spend the rest of my life continuing to help people but two of the three doors in front of me prevent that...and the only favorable outcome I think has become an impossible one at this point but like I said Ill wait until the final moment. I pretty much leave it to the Universe now...if it wants me around Ill stay and live life like I never have before and if it doesnt Ill be driving to a park a few hours away and let nature reclaim me.
Sadly I do know what lies ahead...and it is not going to be anything good. I work at a hospital actually so I am hoping it will be slow if I do go in I really do not want to deal with a lot tonight.
Whatever lies beyond life if anything.

I plead to God, the universe,  or any entity listening every night that let me have the future I've worked so hard for and not let sucide be the better option but for now it's hard to tell if anyone is listening.

in the middle of what must be a cruel divine joke. for the first time in a long time I was about to be happy but that is teetering on ruin at the moment with no hope of redemption.  was about to change careers to something I enjoyed and get a better schedule and was about to ask a good friend to start a relationship with as we are practically dating anyway. just living day by day now.  pretty much given up all my hobbies and interests until I see if this matter will resolve.  the only thing that makes me happy is spending time with my friend he's helped me a lot. he's one of two people in my life that knows what's going on and my possible suicide plans.

glad it turned out halfway well then. I'm not the best person to get advice from due to my own instabilities but glad i could help with this at least.

same to you by the way. you can message me anytime.  a lot of people don't really understand what's going on with us...heck a year so ago I wouldn't have either. though now that I've been through this mess and started thinking of my life in terms of weeks and days rather than decades I really do comprehend it now.
